intent_en: To demonstrate that Trump supporters' confidence in the accuracy of vote counting increased significantly after his 2016 election victory.
previous_intent: To demonstrate the substantial increase in confidence among Trump voters regarding the accuracy of vote counting after their candidate won the election, contrasting with the lower pre-election confidence and the relative stability of Clinton voters.
narration_support: When Trump won the 2016 election, his voters suddenly become much more confident in the process
chart_support: Stacked bar chart comparing confidence levels of Trump and Clinton voters in August and November 2016, showing a substantial increase in confidence for Trump voters post-election.
evidence_note: The narration explicitly states voters became more confident after winning in 2016, and the chart visualizes this increase for Trump voters between August and November 2016, while Clinton voter confidence remained relatively stable.
